description_en: Modifies the name and description of a policy-based route rule in the policy-based route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 修改企业版转发路由器策略路由表中策略路由规则的名称和描述
name: UpdateTransitRouterPolicyBasedRoute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value from your client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request and does not update the policy-based route rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request and directly updates the policy-based route rule after the check succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新策略路由规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更新策略路由规则
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the policy-based routing rule
parameters.name: policy_based_route_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the policy-based route rule.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由规则的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the policy-based route rule.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由规则的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description
